result.brief: 提出 RoboDyna 动态操作基准，含 20 个动态任务与 10 个家居任务、3500 条专家演示及同步/异步评测协议，并分析世界-动作模型的预测保真度与任务成功率关系。
result.reason: Benchmark for manipulation policies under physically grounded dynamics, evaluating a world-action model's prediction fidelity versus task success; main contribution is benchmark/evaluation rather than world modeling itself.
